name: Kurdistan-Turkey Gas Export Pipeline

values.OtherEnglishNames: KRG-Turkey Gas Export Pipeline; Rosneft KRG Gas Pipeline; KRG Gas Export Pipeline
values.RouteNotes: No published route or GIS. Never-built cross-border export leg intended to extend the domestic KRI gas network from the Duhok area toward the Fishkhabour border crossing (a new KRG metering station north of the federal Fishkhabour station) and into Turkish gas infrastructure. LengthKnown/Diameter left blank pending a defined route.

researcher_notes: NEW ROW (status shelved). Distinct cross-border Iraq->Turkey gas export pipeline; NOT a duplicate of the captured domestic KRI segments (P4047 Khormor-Erbil, P4053 Erbil-Duhok, P7457 Semel-Duhok), all of which terminate inside Iraq. GEM Turkey/Iraq gas rosters carry no equivalent gas export row (web/GEM search surfaced only OIL lines at Fishkhabour: Kurdistan Oil Pipeline, Kirkuk-Ceyhan). P4053 (52-in Erbil-Duhok) is the domestic feeder built with headroom for future exports, not this cross-border leg. ADD-THRESHOLD MET: (a) sponsor = Rosneft PJSC + KRG MNR; (b) endpoints = Kurdistan Region (Duhok/Fishkhabour) -> Turkey; (c) concrete step = 2013 KRG-Turkey energy framework + signed 18 Sep 2017 Rosneft agreement (BOOT, up to 30 bcm/y, commissioning planned 2019, exports 2020). This is well beyond early rumor, so it clears monitor. STATUS = shelved rather than cancelled: never reached construction, no gas-export development since 2017, Rosneft partially divested (Nov 2025), and it was widely presumed cancelled by ~2021, BUT the 2025 Newlines analysis reports the export ambition is still live (stalled by KDP-PUK dispute), and there is no formal cancellation. CONFIDENCE = medium: the 30 bcm/y Rosneft-sponsored gas export pipeline PROPOSAL is corroborated by >=2 independent sources (Rosneft press release + Washington Institute; also pgjonline), which is high-confidence for existence of the proposal; but the precise route/endpoints are vague (no GIS), the current shelved status is inferential, and capacity/timeline trace largely to the Rosneft-origin figure. CAVEATS: Owner is the ORIGINAL sponsor Rosneft PJSC (existing entity ID 100, no new entity created) with a note that Rosneft partially divested from KRG pipeline infrastructure in Nov 2025; a large share of reporting conflates this gas scheme with the separate KRG-Rosneft OIL export pipeline. Route/geometry left blank ('no route'), LengthKnown/Diameter blank pending a defined corridor. Owner [ref] belongs on the operators/owners tab per project convention.
